item.title: Cruising the dam at Blyde River Canyon
item.description: Explore Blyde River Canyon via boat during a 90 minute cruise on the Blyderivierspoort Dam in Mpumalanga. Keep a watchful eye for the abundance of wildlife - hippo, leopard, crocodiles and fish eagle call the dam home. The highlights are the rare living Kadishi Tufa waterfall and the Three Rondavels high above. Kadishi Tufa waterfall is 200m high and is the second tallest tufa waterfall on Earth. item.title: 12 Great White Sharks spotted circling Plettenberg Bay
item.description: During an aerial survey of the Plettenberg Bay coastline on Wednesday - from Robberg to Keurboomstrand - 12 Great White Sharks were clearly visible. Bitou Environmental Management and Plett Great White Shark Research noted ‘an incredibly healthy ecosystem’. Large and small fish, several species of rays, dolphins and sharks were sighted. item.title: An authentic English break at Betty's Boutique Hotel
